tips.label: 單數與複數
tips.text: 一個可數物品用單數名詞；兩個以上用複數名詞。一般加 -s，部分字尾加 -es 或有不規則變化。

tips.label: 遠近指示詞
tips.text: 近處單數用 this、遠處單數用 that；近處複數用 these、遠處複數用 those。回答時分別用 it 或 they。

tips.label: What 問物品
tips.text: 單數用 What is this/that/it?；複數用 What are these/those/they?。

tips.label: 所有格
tips.text: 人稱所有格放在名詞前；單數名詞通常加 's，以 s 結尾的複數名詞只加 '。

notes.title: 可數名詞的單複數
notes.rule: a/an + 單數名詞；數字、these、those + 複數名詞
notes.description: 一般名詞加 -s；字尾為 -ch、-s、-x、-sh 時加 -es；子音加 y 時去 y 加 -ies；部分 -f 或 -fe 字尾改為 -ves。sheep、mouse、ox、person 等有特殊變化。
examples: This is a fox. Those are foxes.
One mouse is here, and two mice are there.

notes.title: 以 What 詢問物品
notes.description: 不知道物品是什麼時用 What 詢問。單數主詞搭配 is，並以 it 回答；複數主詞搭配 are，並以 they 回答。
examples: What is this? It is a picture.
What are those? They are zebras.

notes.title: be 動詞 Yes／No 問答
notes.rule: Is + 單數主詞...?／Are + 複數主詞...?
notes.description: 把 be 動詞移到主詞前形成問句。單數簡答用 Yes, it is. 或 No, it isn't.；複數簡答用 Yes, they are. 或 No, they aren't.。
examples: Is that a tiger? Yes, it is.
Are these goats? No, they aren't.

notes.title: this、that、these、those
notes.rule: this/these 表近處；that/those 表遠處
notes.description: this 與 that 後接單數名詞，these 與 those 後接複數名詞。指示代名詞需同時配合距離和單複數。

notes.title: 人稱代名詞所有格
notes.description: 所有格放在名詞前表示擁有者，後面必須接名詞，而且不可再和 a、an、the 或指示詞一起使用。

notes.title: 名詞所有格
notes.rule: 單數名詞 + 's；以 s 結尾的複數名詞 + '；不以 s 結尾的複數名詞 + 's
notes.description: 兩人共同擁有一物時只在第二個名字後加 's；兩人分別擁有時，兩個名字都加 's。
examples: Andy and Helen's house is big.
Amy's and Mia's children are cute.

quiz.question: One monkey is here, and two ___ are there.
quiz.hint: monkey 是母音加 y，複數直接加 s。

quiz.question: We can see three ___ near the tree.
quiz.hint: three 後接複數；fox 以 x 結尾，加 es。

quiz.question: The two ___ are very cute.
quiz.hint: baby 以子音加 y 結尾，去 y 加 ies。

quiz.question: There are two ___ on the table.
quiz.hint: two 後用複數；knife 的複數為 knives。

quiz.question: One sheep is white, and three ___ are black.
quiz.hint: sheep 的單複數同形。

quiz.question: These two ___ are small.
quiz.hint: mouse 的不規則複數是 mice。

quiz.question: Five ___ are in the classroom.
quiz.hint: person 在此表示人的複數用 people。

quiz.question: Those two ___ are big.
quiz.hint: ox 的不規則複數是 oxen。

quiz.question: My sister has three ___.
quiz.hint: three 後接複數；picture 直接加 s。

quiz.question: Those two ___ are new.
quiz.hint: watch 以 ch 結尾，複數加 es。

quiz.question: The farmer has four ___.
quiz.hint: four 後接複數，goat 直接加 s。

quiz.question: There are two ___ beside the door.
quiz.hint: box 以 x 結尾，複數加 es。

quiz.question: The three ___ are in the park.
quiz.hint: child 的不規則複數是 children。

quiz.question: This is a ___.
quiz.hint: a 後接單數可數名詞 rabbit。

quiz.question: ___ pictures in my hands are new.
quiz.hint: in my hands 表近處，pictures 是複數，用 These。

quiz.question: ___ rabbit right here beside me is white.
quiz.hint: right here beside me 表近處，rabbit 是單數，用 This。

quiz.question: ___ horse over there is Peter's.
quiz.hint: over there 表遠處，horse 是單數，用 That。

quiz.question: ___ zebras far from us are beautiful.
quiz.hint: far from us 表遠處，zebras 是複數，用 Those。

quiz.question: Look at this picture in my hand. ___ is my favorite.
quiz.hint: this picture in my hand 指近處單數，用 This。

quiz.question: Look at the oxen over there. ___ are very big.
quiz.hint: oxen 是複數，over there 表遠處，用 Those。

quiz.question: ___ is my watch here on my wrist.
quiz.hint: 手腕上的手錶是近處單數，用 This。

quiz.question: ___ are my books right here beside me.
quiz.hint: right here beside me 表近處，books 是複數，用 These。

quiz.question: A: ___ is this? B: It is a picture.
quiz.hint: 回答辨認物品是 picture，問物品用 What。

quiz.question: What ___ those animals over there?
quiz.hint: those animals 是複數，搭配 are。

quiz.question: What ___ this animal in the picture?
quiz.hint: this animal 是單數，搭配 is。

quiz.question: A: What is that? B: ___ is a Chinese dragon.
quiz.hint: that 指單數，回答用 It，搭配 is。

quiz.question: A: What are these? B: ___ are animal signs.
quiz.hint: these 指複數物品，回答用 They。

quiz.question: A: What are those? B: They ___ watches.
quiz.hint: 回答主詞 They 是複數，搭配 are。

quiz.question: ___ these your rabbits?
quiz.hint: these 是複數，問句以 Are 開頭。

quiz.question: ___ that an elephant in the picture?
quiz.hint: that 是單數，問句以 Is 開頭。

quiz.question: A: Is this a tiger? B: Yes, ___ is.
quiz.hint: this 指單隻動物，標準簡答用 it。

quiz.question: A: Are those zebras? B: Yes, they ___.
quiz.hint: they 是複數，搭配 are。

quiz.question: A: Are these mice? B: No, they ___. They are rats.
quiz.hint: No 與後句 rats 表示否定；they 搭配 aren't。

quiz.question: A: Is that a snake? B: No, ___. It is a rope.
quiz.hint: that 用 it 回答；實際是繩子，所以用 it isn't。

quiz.question: I am Ivan. This is ___ picture.
quiz.hint: picture 前需要 I 的所有格 my。

quiz.question: You have a rabbit. This is ___ rabbit.
quiz.hint: 名詞 rabbit 前用 you 的所有格 your。

quiz.question: He has a rooster. That is ___ rooster.
quiz.hint: 名詞 rooster 前用 he 的所有格 his。

quiz.question: Amy has a goat. This is ___ goat.
quiz.hint: Amy 是女性，名詞 goat 前用所有格 her。

quiz.question: We have two horses. These are ___ horses.
quiz.hint: 名詞 horses 前用 we 的所有格 our。

quiz.question: They have new books. Those are ___ books.
quiz.hint: 名詞 books 前用 they 的所有格 their。

quiz.question: The tiger has a long tail. ___ tail is strong.
quiz.hint: tail 前需所有格 Its；It's 等於 It is。

quiz.question: My brother has a watch. This is ___ watch.
quiz.hint: My brother 是單數男性，名詞前用所有格 his。

quiz.question: Amy and I have a rabbit. This is ___ rabbit.
quiz.hint: Amy and I 包含說話者，相當於 we，所有格用 our。

quiz.question: These girls have pictures. Those are ___ pictures.
quiz.hint: These girls 是複數，名詞前用所有格 their。

quiz.question: Peter has a horse. That is ___ horse.
quiz.hint: 單數人名 Peter 後加 's 表示所有格。

quiz.question: These puppies have the same mother. She is the ___ mother.
quiz.hint: 擁有者是多隻 puppies，字尾已有 s，只加撇號。

quiz.question: The children have new books. These are the ___ books.
quiz.hint: children 是不以 s 結尾的複數，所有格加 's。

quiz.question: The two girls share a room. This is the ___ room.
quiz.hint: two girls 指兩人，複數 girls 以 s 結尾，只加撇號。

quiz.question: Andy and Helen share one house. This is ___ house.
quiz.hint: 兩人共同擁有同一間房子，只在最後一個名字後加 's。

quiz.question: John has a room, and Mary has a different room. These are ___ rooms.
quiz.hint: 兩人各有不同房間，分別擁有時兩個名字都加 's。
